description: Sub-workflow for one message to the Lark bot, called by 'Content agent: lark'. Re-reads the message from the Lark API. Direct messages are accepted from the owner (the first person to message the bot); in groups only the team chat is served, and only messages that @mention the bot or start with a /command. /link by the owner in a group makes it the team chat, where everyone is equal. Instant commands (/help, /status, /story, /inspiring) run without AI; /rule, /goal, /offers, /plan, /draft and /review go to the agent as focused tasks; anything else goes to the agent as chat, with the thread's history. Pictures replied to a draft card attach to that post; other screenshots in a direct message are saved as inspiration.
name: Content agent: lark message

const d = $('Decide').first().json;
if (d.access !== 'link_group') return [];
return [{ json: { reply_to: d.reply_to, text: `This group is now my team chat. Everyone here is equal: @mention me or use /commands, approve cards, set goals and rules. My daily questions, draft cards, publish notices and weekly reports come here from now on.

${"Commands (in the group, write them as they are or after @mentioning me):
/story <what happened>: save a real moment for future stories
/inspiring + screenshots of a post: save it as inspiration
/status: the next 14 days
/rule <rule>: a rule I always follow from now on
/goal <goal>: set or change a goal
/offers [YYYY-MM]: propose offers (default next month)
/plan [notes]: plan every free day up to the last approved offer
/draft <post id> [notes]: write that post now
/review: run the weekly review now
/link: (in a group, by the owner) make this group the team chat
Anything else: @mention me and talk. In threads I started (cards, questions, my answers) no @mention is needed. Reply to a draft card in its thread to change it, or with photos to add pictures to that post."}` } }];
